title: finding(spec): two live-window page-property aliases (`page:header` `description`, an inline `api` action's object `params`) are converted at `os validate` and at load but not at the metadata save door, which now runs the component-props rule (PR #23418)
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): one operation, two implementations that disagree. `os validate` and the load path apply the ADR-0087 D2 conversions `page-header-subtitle-alias` (`description` → `subtitle`) and `inline-action-api-params-to-body-extra` (object `params` → `bodyExtra`) before the component-props rule judges a page; the metadata save door judges the raw page, so the same page is converted silently by the CLI and refused with `422 component-props-unknown-key` at `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME`.

`reach:` the metadata save door, once PR #23418 (card #23388, ruling B) moves `validateComponentProps` onto it. Measured by that PR's dev on the in-repo page fixtures, raw against normalized input: 5 and 3 save-door-only findings for the two conversions; the other 29 page conversions give identical findings either way. Not yet measured with a live save; the claimant re-measures. Source: the #23388 dev report `6163297010`, `out_of_scope_findings` entry 3. PR #23418's changeset already names the gap for authors.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`, at PR #23418's review. ⛔ Not a claim; grading and routing are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the seat that owns `packages/spec/src/conversions` (triage routes). The dev's reading: both conversions declare `toMajor 17` (`retiresIn 18`) but are not `retiredFromLoadPath` at `18.0.0-next`, so their window is overdue on the v18 line. Two answers are in sight: retire both from the load path at 18 (then every door refuses the old spelling with the rename, consistently), or have the save door apply the live-window conversions before it judges. Which one is the owning seat's call against ADR-0087.
